title: see what your company pays for, free
excerpt: Spendgap shows every tool your company pays for, what went up, and which invoices are missing. Free.
content_html:
We collect your invoices and help you pay less. Free.

Find missing invoices, spot wasted money on software, catch price rises and renewals, and get the emails to your vendors already written.

Pay less, with the email already written

Pick what you want for each tool. Spendgap writes the email from your bills, and you send it from your own address.

An email to your vendor with what you pay, what went up and when it renews. Change anything, then send it.

You pay$500 a month, 5 seats

It went upFrom $439

It renewsIn 12 days

Your own AI finds tools that fit, and there's an email ready for each vendor you'd like an offer from.

IntercomToday $480/mo

ZendeskEmail ready

Help ScoutEmail ready

When to cancel to skip the next charge, where to do it, and an email if there's no button. Then we watch that the charges stop.

LoomCancel before 3 Dec

AsanaCharged again

ZendeskCharges stopped

Overlapping tools, double charges and cancelled tools that keep billing.

DropboxSame job as Google Drive: $90

AsanaTwo subscriptions: $134.90

Notion4 unused seats: $40/mo

Invoice collection for you and your accountant

Your AI collects the invoices you already have, or you forward them. A forwarding rule then picks up each new one.

We send your invoices to your accountant automatically, with nothing for you to send.

See the 3 steps

First check in 3 steps

Start with your last three months of bank statements.

  1. Upload your statements

    Bank or card, PDF or CSV. Your invoices come from Claude or ChatGPT, or you forward them.

  2. See where the money goes

    Every tool, monthly and yearly totals, renewals coming up and price rises.

  3. Choose what happens next

    Keep it, pay less, explore options or cancel. The emails are written for you.

All your spending in one place

What you pay each month, where it goes and what's coming next.

Bank statement reconciliation

Upload a bank or card statement and see which charges have no invoice yet.

Check every charge

We check each charge against your invoices, so you know what's covered.

AWS$312.40, invoice matched

Slack$157.50, invoice matched

Asana$134.90, invoice missing

Get what's missing

Missing invoices go on a list, and your AI can collect them from each vendor's billing page. You share no passwords with us.

AsanaOctober invoice missing

ZendeskOctober invoice missing

LoomCollected today

Catch price rises, extra seats and renewals in time

We watch every bill, so you don't have to.

No unnoticed price rises

You know when a bill went up and whether it's a higher price, more seats or more usage.

HubSpotPrice up 14%

AWSMore usage: up 22%

SlackMore seats: up 9%

No paying for spare seats

A bill with more seats than your team has people gets flagged, so you can drop the extra.

Slack18 seats, team of 11

Loom6 seats, team of 11

Notion15 seats, team of 11

No surprise renewals

Yearly renewals reach you early enough to cancel, downgrade or ask for a lower price.

HubSpotIn 12 days

FigmaIn 40 days

ZendeskIn 75 days

Review page for every tool

See what you pay for each tool, the plan, the seats and the next charge. Choose keep, pay less, explore options or cancel, and the next step is ready.

Why it's free

We built Spendgap from our own pain: chasing invoices every month and paying for software we'd forgotten about. It's new, and right now we want people using it more than we want to charge for it.

People who use it, tell us what's missing and tell others about it.

Hosting and the AI that reads your files cost money, and we pay for them. To keep that possible, we read up to 100 invoices a month for each company. Any more wait for the next month.

Your data. We don't sell your bills, what you pay or the list of tools you use, and there are no ads.

We can't promise what hosting will cost us in a few years. If something changes we'll email you first, and you're never charged unless you choose it.

No passwords, no direct Gmail connection

We only get the bills you send: your AI finds them with your permission, or you forward or upload them.

Vendor logins stay in your own browser. Statements are deleted after 7 days, and we never sell your data.

Read about security

Questions

What people ask before their first check.

Do you read my Gmail?

No. Your own AI assistant reads it with your permission and sends us only bills, receipts, renewal notices and trials.

Do you need my passwords?

No. Your AI collects invoices in your own browser, where you're already signed in. We never ask for your passwords or store them.

Can a vendor be emailed without me?

No. Spendgap never writes to a vendor. It drafts emails, and you send the ones you want from your own address.

Can't ChatGPT or Claude do this alone?

It can read a statement once. Spendgap keeps every month together, so you see what went up, what's missing and what renews next.

Can I do this without AI?

You don't need an AI account. Forward your recent bills from Gmail in one go, or upload them. Spendgap uses AI to read them.
